<li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>Our free version</strong> of Katalon Studio offers basic test automation needs. </span></li>
<li><span data-sheets-root="1">For those ready for advanced test creation, but with more limited execution needs, <strong>the Create plan</strong> give you access to Katalon Studio Enterprise. <br></span></li>
<li><span data-sheets-root="1">If you need parallel test execution, <strong>the Expand plan</strong> adds this in the form of Katalon Runtime Engine, which allows you to run tests in your own environment, or Katalon TrueTest, where you can use Katalon's cloud for test execution.</span></li>

<section class="faq-module faq-module__729 bg-white  p-y-large   " id="">
  <div class="main-wrapper">
    
    <div class="faq-module--wrapper">
      <h2 class="text-black center-aligned  ">
        Frequently asked questions
      </h2>      
      
      <div class="faq-accordion--wrapper">
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">How do I know which plan is right for me?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p><strong>Free Plan:</strong><br>Ideal for individuals or small teams starting their test automation journey. You can create and run basic automated tests for web, mobile, and API applications. Perfect for learning or tackling small projects.</p>
<p><strong>Premium Plan:</strong><br>Ideal for teams of all sizes looking to streamline and enhance their testing process. Includes everything in the Free Plan, plus:</p>
<ul>
<li><span>Faster test creation:</span><span> </span>Write tests faster with advanced low-code/full-code editing and built-in execution, debugging, and reporting tools, and AI-powered assistance with<span> </span><span>Katalon Studio Enterprise.</span></li>
<li><span>Seamless CI/CD integration and flexible remote execution:</span>
<ul>
<li>Run tests remotely on your infrastructure with<span> </span><span>Katalon Runtime Engine</span>.</li>
<li>Leverage cloud environments with various browsers, operating systems, and Android and iOS apps using advanced mobile device controls with<span> </span><span>Katalon TestCloud</span>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Ultimate Plan:</strong><br>Ideal for large enterprises or cutting-edge teams with extensive testing programs requiring centralized management, advanced AI capabilities, and comprehensive support for complex needs.</p>
<p>Everything in the Premium Plan, plus:</p>
<ul>
<li><span>Centralized management:</span><span> </span>Manage your testing process from a central command center with Katalon TestOps and enjoy features like advanced reporting and analytics, advanced organization, and license management.</li>
<li><span>Advanced AI-powered testing:</span><span> </span>Utilize features like TrueTest for AI-powered regression testing, virtual data analysis, AI visual testing, manual test generation, and more.</li>
<li><span>Scalability and security:</span><span> </span>Scale your testing with features like unlimited tests with TestOps, flexible hosting and security configurations, on-premises options for licenses and TestOps, and private SaaS deployment.</li>
<li><span>Enhanced support:</span><span> </span>Get premium support with 24/7 coverage, dedicated onboarding, and strategic advisory services for advanced testing transformations.</li>
</ul><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">How many licenses do I need?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p><span><strong>Test creation:</strong><br></span>The number of Katalon Studio Enterprise licenses = The number of users creating tests.</p>
<p><span><strong>Remote execution:</strong><br></span>The number of Katalon Runtime Engine licenses/Katalon TestCloud sessions = The number of parallel executions you want to run simultaneously.</p><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">Can I purchase single license in Premium?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p>Yes, the Premium Plan offers the flexibility to purchase single licenses starting with Katalon Studio Enterprise for test creation and local execution.</p>
<p>From there, you can add TestCloud for cloud-based execution, Runtime Engine for on-premises remote execution, or TestOps for test management, depending on your specific needs.</p><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">Where can I learn more about each of Katalon's product offerings? </h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p>You can find specific information about each solution on our website:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/katalon-studio" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Katalon Studio Enterprise</a></li>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/katalon-runtime-engine" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Katalon Runtime Engine</a></li>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/testcloud" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Katalon TestCloud</a></li>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/truetest" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Katalon TrueTest</a></li>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/testops" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Katalon TestOps</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Each product serves different testing goals, such as parallel test execution or advanced analytics. Reviewing these resources will help you decide which tools best complement your workflow.</p><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">What payment options do I have?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p>You can purchase Katalon licenses through:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://admin.katalon.com/home?subscribe=true">Online payment:</a>
<ul>
<li>Credit card</li>
<li>Bank transfer (US customers only)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><a href="https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/seller-profile?id=0b164fbc-9d79-4d89-a8f3-39270e68e347" target="_blank" rel="noopener">AWS Marketplace</a></li>
<li><a href="https://katalon.com/partners">Katalon resellers and partners</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Need assistance on the evaluation process or procurement process?<span> </span><a href="#contactus" rel="noopener">Contact Sales<span> </span>-></a></p><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">Is there a monthly plan for Katalon licenses? Can I buy it annually?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><p>Katalon offers both a monthly and annual subscription.</p>
<p>Choosing the annual plan saves you 20% compared to paying monthly.</p>
<p>You cannot combine monthly and annual plans for the same Katalon license.</p><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">Can I subscribe to a mix of free and paid subscriptions at the same time?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><div>
<div>
<p>No, you cannot subscribe to a mix of free and paid Katalon subscriptions at the same time within a project or organization. This is to ensure compliance with our terms and conditions. For details, please take a look at our<span> </span><a href="https://katalon.com/terms#customer-terms-of-use" target="_blank" rel="noopener">terms and conditions</a>.</p>
</div>
</div><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
        
        
        
            <div class="faq-item">
              <div class="accordion-header text-body4  header--style-1  "><h3 class="text-body4 faq--style-1  ">Is Katalon deployed locally?</h3><div class="faq-plus--icon">+</div></div>
              <div class="text-body5 accordion-content ">
                <p class="text-body5  small-size   "></p><div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<div>
<p>Studio is an IDE application, install locally on Windows, MacOS, Linux machine.</p>
<p>Runtime Engine is on-prem for you to flexibly manage via your preferred infrastructure.</p>
<p>TestCloud and TestOps are hosted on AWS US East.</p>
<p>We do offer additional private deployment configurations to your cloud provider location/data center for:</p>
<ul>
<li>Katalon TestOps: Public SaaS, Private SaaS, and On-Premises</li>
<li>Katalon Studio: On-premises, Offline license</li>
<li>Katalon Runtime Engine: On-premises, Offline license</li>
<li>Katalon TestCloud: Public SaaS and Private SaaS</li>
</ul>
<p>Have private SaaS or on-premises needs?<span> </span><a href="#contactus" rel="noopener">Contact Sales<span> </span>-></a></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div><p></p>
              </div>
            </div>
